description: Source file implementing Bluetooth HCI socket operations and management commands, including advertising, inquiry, scanning, device management, and event handling within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: HCISocket
classes.description: Class handling Bluetooth HCI socket communication, including command exchange, event processing, and device management.

classes.name: EIR
classes.description: Class for processing Extended Inquiry Response (EIR) data, extracting device name, class, and UUIDs.

classes.name: ManagementType
classes.description: Template class for managing Bluetooth management protocol commands, handling serialization, deserialization, and response processing.

classes.name: ManagementFixedType
classes.description: Template class for fixed-size management commands with predefined payloads.

classes.name: ManagementListType
classes.description: Template class for management commands that handle lists of items, such as link keys or UUIDs.

methods.name: HCISocket::Advertising
methods.description: Enables or disables Bluetooth advertising with specified mode.

methods.name: HCISocket::Inquiry
methods.description: Performs a Bluetooth device inquiry scan for a specified duration and mode.

methods.name: HCISocket::AbortInquiry
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing device inquiry.

methods.name: HCISocket::Scan
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth scanning with specified parameters.

methods.name: HCISocket::AbortScan
methods.description: Stops ongoing Bluetooth scanning.

methods.name: HCISocket::Discovery
methods.description: Enables or disables Bluetooth device discovery mode.

methods.name: HCISocket::ReadStoredLinkKeys
methods.description: Reads stored link keys for a given Bluetooth address.

methods.name: HCISocket::StateChange
methods.description: Handles socket state changes, setting appropriate Bluetooth event filters.

methods.name: HCISocket::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes incoming HCI event data and updates internal state.

methods.name: HCISocket::Update
methods.description: Virtual method to update internal state based on received events.

methods.name: EIR::Ingest
methods.description: Processes raw EIR buffer data to extract device name, class, and UUIDs.

methods.name: Management::Devices
methods.description: Retrieves list of Bluetooth device adapters.

methods.name: Management::Name
methods.description: Sets the local Bluetooth device name.

methods.name: Management::DeviceClass
methods.description: Sets the Bluetooth device class.

methods.name: Management::AddUUID
methods.description: Adds a UUID to the device's list of supported UUIDs.

methods.name: Management::RemoveUUID
methods.description: Removes a UUID from the device's list of supported UUIDs.

methods.name: Management::AddAdvertising
methods.description: Adds an advertising instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: Management::RemoveAdvertising
methods.description: Removes advertising instances.

methods.name: Management::Discoverable
methods.description: Sets the device discoverability mode.

methods.name: Management::Power
methods.description: Turns Bluetooth power on or off.

methods.name: Management::Connectable
methods.description: Enables or disables connectability.

methods.name: Management::FastConnectable
methods.description: Enables or disables fast connectability.

methods.name: Management::Block
methods.description: Blocks a Bluetooth device address.

methods.name: Management::Unblock
methods.description: Unblocks a Bluetooth device address.

methods.name: Management::AddDevice
methods.description: Adds a Bluetooth device for auto-connection.

methods.name: Management::RemoveDevice
methods.description: Removes a Bluetooth device.

methods.name: Management::Pair
methods.description: Initiates pairing with a remote device.

methods.name: Management::Unpair
methods.description: Removes pairing with a remote device.

methods.name: Management::PairAbort
methods.description: Aborts ongoing pairing process.

methods.name: Management::UserPINCodeReply
methods.description: Replies with a PIN code during pairing.

methods.description: Replies with a passkey during pairing.

methods.name: Management::UserPasskeyNegReply
methods.description: Rejects passkey request.

methods.description: Confirms or rejects passkey confirmation.

methods.name: Management::Notifications

methods.description: Retrieves current Bluetooth management settings.
